sentences.en: He swallowed a piece of toast because he was starving.
sentences.zh: 他咽下了一片面包因为饿坏了。

sentences.en: Many's the long night I've dreamed of cheese — toasted mostly.
sentences.zh: 不知有多少个漫长的夜晚我梦见奶酪——大多是烤过的。

sentences.en: I only have toast and coffee in the morning.
sentences.zh: 早上我只吃吐司和咖啡。
